name: fablecut
description: Zero-dependency multi-project video timeline MCP service with a parallel browser editor.
long_description: FableCut combines a Premiere-style browser editor with a multi-project MCP service. Agents create and patch schema-versioned project.json timelines through stdio or unauthenticated Streamable HTTP; independent clients consume structured project output and resolve upstream asset IDs. Includes conflict-safe concurrent edits and reference-video analysis.

data_directory.title: FableCut MCP data directory
data_directory.description: Persistent project.json storage for the local MCP adapter

tools.name: fablecut_create_project
tools.description: Create a project and return its generated projectId and project.json

tools.name: fablecut_status
tools.description: Return a selected project summary and MCP service status

tools.name: fablecut_docs
tools.description: Return the project schema and editing manual without requiring a project

tools.name: fablecut_get_project
tools.description: Return project.json as structured content, with compact mode for planning

tools.name: fablecut_set_project
tools.description: Replace project.json with revision-based optimistic concurrency

tools.name: fablecut_patch_project
tools.description: Apply serialized targeted edits to the latest project revision

tools.name: fablecut_import_media
tools.description: Register immutable upstream asset metadata in a project

tools.name: fablecut_analyze_reference
tools.description: Temporarily analyze an upstream reference asset into cuts, beats, BPM, energy and drop
